InvestigationPatterns.Name: CompromisedInstanceInvestigation
InvestigationPatterns.Description: Investigate a GuardDuty finding for a compromised EC2 instance
Queries: Which IAM role is attached to the instance?
What API calls has the instance made in the last 24 hours?
What network connections has the instance made?
Is this instance communicating with known-bad IPs?
Are other resources using the same credentials?
What resources did the instance access?

InvestigationPatterns.Name: CompromisedCredentialInvestigation
Queries: What API calls were made with this key?
Was this pattern normal for this user/role?
What data was exfiltrated, if any?

InvestigationPatterns.Name: CryptominingInvestigation
Queries: What instance type and region was used?
What DNS queries has the instance made?
What IPs has it connected to?
What other instances share the same activity pattern?
What user or role launched the instance?
